original_question: Rory ta ba da umarnin a kawo mata biredin sub guda 2 akan $7.50 kowanne, buhuna 2 na dankali akan $1.50 kowanne da kuma biskit 2 akan $1.00 ladan kawo kowanne. Akwai ƙarin kuɗin kaiwa da kashi 20% a lissafin kuma tana son ƙara ƙarin $5.00. Menene kudin odar ta?
question_template: {name_male, Rory} ta ba da umarnin a kawo mata biredin sub guda {num_digit_1, 2} akan ${num_digit_2, 7.50} kowanne, buhuna {num_digit_3, 2} na dankali akan ${num_digit_4, 1.50} kowanne da kuma biskit {num_digit_5, 2} akan ${num_digit_6, 1.00} ladan kawo kowanne. Akwai ƙarin kuɗin kaiwa da kashi {num_digit_7, 20}% a lissafin kuma tana son ƙara ƙarin ${num_digit_8, 5.00}. Menene kudin odar ta?
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_1 * num_digit_2 + num_digit_3 * num_digit_4 + num_digit_5 * num_digit_6) * (1 + num_digit_7 / 100) + num_digit_8
